LanguageData.XPC_Learning_DailyCapDescription: Sets how much XP a pawn can gain at full learning efficiency each day before Further Learning applies.
LanguageData.XPC_Learning_DailyCapZero: 0 XP means there is no daily full-rate XP allowance after learning begins.
LanguageData.XPC_Learning_SourceOn: ON: matching traits, genes, health effects, and ideology sources modify the base capacity below.
LanguageData.XPC_Learning_SourceOff: OFF: XP Customizer does not add source-based Daily Capacity bonuses or penalties.
LanguageData.XPC_Learning_SourceConversion: Global learning bonus to DLC conversion: {0}% (strength {1}%)
LanguageData.XPC_Learning_SourceStrengthRange: 0% = none | 100% = convert 20% of vanilla LF bonus | 200% = convert 40%
LanguageData.XPC_Learning_SourceAutoDescription: Auto converts the nominal vanilla learning effect into DLC. Custom overrides ONLY that source's final DLC percentage.
LanguageData.XPC_Learning_SourceCustomDescription: Custom is NOT multiplied by the global slider; -100% to +100%. Example cap assumes one source, current base, and 100% Consciousness.
LanguageData.XPC_Learning_SourceResetAuto: Use Auto formula for all sources
LanguageData.XPC_Learning_ModeCustomTooltip: Custom: fixed final DLC bonus/penalty, independent of the global slider. Click for Auto.
LanguageData.XPC_Learning_ModeAutoTooltip: Auto: vanilla LF source bonus × current conversion. Click to edit final DLC %.
LanguageData.XPC_Learning_FurtherDescription: Controls learning efficiency after daily full-rate learning is exhausted.
LanguageData.XPC_Learning_ThresholdDescription: Lower break thresholds boost post-cap learning; higher thresholds reduce it.
LanguageData.XPC_Learning_ThresholdRange: 0% = no effect | 60% = mod default | 100% = reference | 200% = double effect
LanguageData.XPC_Learning_TraitExamplesDescription: Single vanilla trait; no additional threshold modifiers or Consciousness.
LanguageData.XPC_Learning_BaseFactorHelp: 0% = no XP after saturation | 100% = no post-cap penalty
